blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated radiology report generation for multi-sequence brain MRI holds strong promise for alleviating radiologists' workload, yet it remains a demanding problem: brain MRI studies are inherently volumetric, each pulse sequence carries complementary diagnostic information, and annotated data are critically scarce for low-resource clinical languages. Existing brain MRI-report resources are still dominated by English reports, translated clinical text, or datasets adapted from task-specific imaging benchmarks, leaving routine low-resource clinical reporting and heterogeneous multi-sequence MRI protocols insufficiently represented. To bridge this gap, we introduce ViBMR, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports, comprising 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series across T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences. Building on ViBMR, we establish a comprehensive evaluation setup for brain MRI report generation, covering representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies. The results provide key insights into dataset characteristics and model behavior, while demonstrating the necessity of native low-resource clinical datasets for reliable Vietnamese-origin brain MRI report generation. Our dataset and baseline models will be released for non-commercial research.
blocks.zh: 为多序列脑磁共振生成自动放射学报告对减轻放射科医生的工作量很有希望,然而,这仍然是一个很棘手的问题:脑磁共振研究本质上是体积的,每个脉冲序列都带有补充性诊断信息,对低资源临床语言而言,附加说明的数据极为稀缺。 现有的大脑核磁共振报告资源仍然以英文报告,翻译临床文本,或根据特定任务成像基准而改编的数据集为主,使得常规的低资源临床报告和多序列核磁共振协议没有得到充分体现. 为了弥合这一差距,我们向大家介绍我们所了解的最早的大规模多序列脑磁共振数据集与越南常规临床报告对接,由3,649名患者和11,875个核磁共振系列组成,跨越了T1,T2,FLAIR,以及对比增强的T1序列. 在生物、生物、MR的基础上,我们为编制脑磁共振报告建立了全面的评价机制,涵盖有代表性的医学视觉语言模型、多序列投入和特征汇总战略。 这些结果提供了对数据集特征和模型行为的关键见解,同时证明了本地低资源临床数据集对于可靠的越南原生脑磁共振报告生成的必要性. 我们的数据集和基线模型将发布,用于非商业研究.

blocks.en:
Addressing these challenges requires two ingredients in tandem: (i) a dataset for a
low-resource language that faithfully reflects routine clinical reporting, and
(ii) a comprehensive empirical study that clarifies which visual components and fusion
strategies are genuinely beneficial for multi-sequence brain MRI report generation.
Existing resources, however, satisfy neither requirement, especially for Vietnamese. In this paper, we bridge this gap through two main contributions:

(二) 一项全面的经验研究,澄清哪些视觉组件和聚变
战略对于多序列脑磁共振报告生成具有真正的益处。
然而,现有资源既满足不了任何需要,尤其是对于越南人而言。 在本文中,我们通过两个主要贡献来弥补这一差距:

blocks.en: First, we introduce ViBMR, the first and, to the best of our knowledge, largest multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports. The dataset is collected from a tertiary hospital in Vietnam and comprises 3,649 patients with 11,875 series. It covers the four MRI sequences commonly used in neuroimaging practice, including T1, T2, FLAIR, and T1c, as well as diverse sequence combinations that reflect the variability of real-world acquisition protocols. The reports are extracted directly from hospital records and exhibit the long-tailed distribution characteristic of clinical practice, ranging from frequent findings such as small vessel disease to rare but clinically significant abnormalities (see Figure 2 ). ViBMR therefore provides a large-scale Vietnamese resource for studying medical report generation in a low-resource language setting.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们介绍ViBMR,第一个, 并且,就我们所知,最大的多序列脑磁共振数据集 与越南常规的临床报告结合。 该数据集由越南一家第三医院收集,由3 649名病人组成,共11 875个系列。 它涵盖了神经成像练习中常用的四种核磁共振序列,包括T1,T2,FLAIR,T1c,以及反映现实世界获取协议的变异性的各种序列组合. 报告直接从医院记录中提取,显示出临床实践的长尾分布特征,从常见的发现,如小船病,到罕见但临床上显著的异常(见图2)。 因此,ViBMR为在低资源语言环境下研究医疗报告生成提供了大规模的越南资源.

blocks.en: Second, building on ViBMR, we conduct a set of research questions around brain MRI report generation in this low-resource setting. We systematically evaluate the transferability of segmentation-pretrained multi-sequence encoders to report generation, analyze the contribution of individual MRI sequences and their combinations, compare multiple feature aggregation strategies ranging from mean fusion and learnable weighted fusion to spatial gating, channel gating, and cross-attention, and quantify the cross-dataset generalization gap between existing datasets and Vietnamese-origin reports. These experiments establish reliable baselines for ViBMR and provide practical empirical insights for future model design in multi-sequence brain MRI report generation.
blocks.zh: 第二,在生物与核磁共振的基础上, 我们围绕大脑核磁共振报告生成 在这种低资源环境下进行一系列研究。 我们系统地评估分解预序编码器的可转移性,以报告生成情况,分析单个核磁共振序列及其组合的贡献,比较从平均聚变和可学习的加权聚变到空间成色、通道成色和跨视距的多种特征聚合策略,并量化现有数据集和越南原产报告之间的跨数据集通用化差距。 这些实验为ViBMR建立了可靠的基线,并为多序列脑磁共振报告生成中的未来模型设计提供了实用的经验性见解.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Public brain MRI datasets have substantially advanced medical image analysis, especially for lesion segmentation, disease classification, and algorithmic benchmarking. Representative benchmarks such as BraTS [ 2 ] , ISLES [ 15 ] , the WMH Segmentation Challenge [ 20 ] , and ATLAS [ 25 ] provide high-quality annotations for specific clinical scenarios, including glioma, stroke lesions, white matter hyperintensities, and post-stroke lesion segmentation. However, these resources are primarily designed for anomaly segmentation tasks, rather than for learning the correspondence between multi-sequence brain MRI studies and free-text diagnostic reports. Recent MRI-text resources have begun to address this gap. RadGenome-Brain MRI [ 24 ] provides brain MRI scans, anomaly segmentation masks, and radiologist-written descriptions for abnormal regions, making them suitable for grounded regional report generation. However, RadGenome-Brain MRI is curated from multiple public anomaly segmentation datasets, followed by manually authored findings and impressions for annotated regions [ 24 ] . Therefore, its report structure differs from routine radiology reports directly collected from hospital workflows. MR-RATE [ 10 ] further expands MRI-text learning by pairing brain and spine MRI studies with radiology reports and metadata. Another important gap is language coverage. Existing MRI image-report resources remain limited for native low-resource clinical languages. Current brain MRI resources are commonly released or standardized in English, including Chinese-to-English processed reports in AutoRG-Brain [ 24 ] and Turkish-to-English reports in MR-RATE [ 10 ] . Beyond brain MRI, Cervical-RG focuses on 3D multi-sequence cervical cancer MRI report generation [ 41 ] , while Auto-Rad and SPINE focus on lumbar or spinal MRI report generation using English or LLM-standardized narrative reports [ 40 , 13 ] . This limitation is important because radiology reports are language, institution, and population-dependent: reporting style, terminology, abbreviation usage, anatomical description granularity, and patient characteristics may differ across hospitals and regions. Therefore, a Vietnamese brain MRI image-report dataset is necessary for studying report generation in a low-resource clinical language setting. In this context, our dataset complements existing brain MRI resources by focusing on routine multi-sequence brain MRI studies paired with Vietnamese clinical reports.
blocks.zh: 公共脑核磁共振数据集具有相当先进的医学图像分析,特别是针对损伤分解,疾病分类和算法基准的分析. BratS[2]、ISLES[15]、WMH分块挑战[20]和ATLAS[25]等代表性基准为特定临床情况提供了高质量的说明,包括胶片瘤、中风损伤、白物质超强度和中风后分块。 然而,这些资源主要用于异常分裂任务,而不是学习多序列脑磁共振研究与自由文本诊断报告之间的对应. 近期的核磁共振文本资源已开始弥补这一差距。 RadGenome-Brain核磁共振[24]提供脑磁共振扫描,异常分解口罩,以及异常区域的放射学家写作的描述,使得它们适合基于基础的区域报告生成. 然而,RadGenome-Brain(英语:RadGenome-Brain)则认为:"我们是人类的人类". 核磁共振由多个公共异常分解数据集整理,然后由人工编写附加说明区域的调查结果和印象[24]。 因此,其报告结构不同于直接从医院工作流程中收集的例行放射报告。 MR-RATE [10]通过将大脑和脊椎核磁共振研究与放射学报告和元数据配对,进一步扩大核磁共振文本学习. 另一个重要差距是语言覆盖面。 现有的磁共振成像报告资源对于当地低资源临床语言来说仍然有限。 目前脑磁共振资源通常以英语发布或标准化,包括AutoRG-Brain[24]中经中英处理的报告和MR-RATE[10]中土耳其语对英语的报告. 除了脑磁共振外,子宫颈-RG还注重3D多序列宫颈癌磁共振报告生成[41],而Auto-Rad和SPINE则注重使用英语或LLM标准化的叙述报告生成Lumbar或脊柱磁共振报告[40,13]. 这一限制很重要,因为放射学报告是语言,机构和人口依赖的:报告风格,名词,缩写用法,解剖描述颗粒性,患者特征可能因医院和地区而异. 因此,越南脑磁共振成像报告数据集对于在低资源临床语言环境中研究报告生成是必要的。 在这方面,我们的数据集对现有的脑磁共振资源进行了补充,侧重于与越南临床报告配套的常规多序列脑磁共振研究。

blocks.en: Recent medical vision-language models have extended report generation and visual question answering from 2D radiology images to volumetric medical imaging. General 3D medical MLLMs such as M3D-LaMed [ 1 ] and Med3DVLM [ 38 ] demonstrate the feasibility of aligning 3D medical images with clinical text for tasks including image-text retrieval, VQA, and report generation. For brain MRI, AutoRG-Brain introduces grounded report generation with lesion and anatomical masks [ 24 ] , PIRTA improves the factuality of acute ischemic stroke report generation from 3D DWI MRI using paired image-domain retrieval and text-domain augmentation [ 23 ] , and Brain3D adapts a 2D medical vision encoder into a native 3D encoder for volumetric brain tumor MRI report generation [ 5 ] . These works demonstrate the potential of 3D visual representations for neuroradiological reporting, but their visual input is commonly formulated as a single volumetric scan 3D image rather than routine multi-sequence brain MRI studies that must be interpreted jointly. Beyond brain MRI, Cervical-RG [ 41 ] addresses multi-sequence cervical cancer MRI report generation by concatenating aligned 3D MRI sequences at the input level before ViT-based visual encoding.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Preprocessing Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据处理 管道

blocks.en: We constructed a large-scale real-world brain MRI dataset collected from a major tertiary hospital in Vietnam, consisting of MRI studies from 3,649 patients with diverse intracranial abnormalities and neurological conditions. The radiology reports were extracted from raw hospital PDF documents through a dedicated preprocessing pipeline. To ensure patient privacy and regulatory compliance, all personally identifiable information and sensitive metadata were removed during the anonymization process. We then extracted the findings section of the reports as the ground-truth target for the report generation task. In parallel, we collected the corresponding MRI volumes for each report and aligned them with the extracted report descriptions. Although the number of MRI sequences varies across patients, four modalities are consistently and commonly used in routine neuroimaging practice: T1-weighted (T1), T2-weighted (T2), Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery (FLAIR), and contrast-enhanced T1-weighted imaging (T1c). These modalities provide complementary diagnostic information regarding anatomical structures, lesion characterization, edema, enhancement patterns, and pathological tissue properties. Therefore, we selected these four volumetric MRI sequences as the primary inputs for our evaluation methods. As shown in Fig. 3 , for each patient, we first organized the DICOM files by study and sequence, and then assembled the ordered slices into volumetric MRI scans using the spatial information stored in the metadata, including slice position, image orientation, and voxel spacing. Since the raw scans were acquired under heterogeneous clinical protocols, the reconstructed volumes may differ in orientation, spatial resolution, field of view, and matrix size. To reduce this variability, all 3D volumes were resampled to an isotropic spatial resolution of 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 mm. We then applied automated brain extraction using HD-BET [ 17 ] to obtain brain masks, which were used to suppress non-brain tissues and crop the intracranial region. This step removes irrelevant background structures while preserving the clinically meaningful anatomical context, allowing the model to process each sequence as a standardized 3D volume while maintaining anatomical continuity across slices.
blocks.zh: 我们建造了一个从越南一家大第三医院收集的大规模现实世界脑磁共振数据集,其中包括3 649名患有不同颅内异常和神经病症的病人的磁共振研究。 放射科报告是通过专用预处理管道从医院原始PDF文件中提取的。 为确保患者的隐私和遵守监管,匿名化过程中删除了所有个人识别的信息和敏感的元数据. 然后,我们提取了报告的结论部分,作为编写报告任务的实地目标。 与此同时,我们为每份报告收集了相应的核磁共振卷,并与摘录的报告说明保持一致。 虽然不同患者的核磁共振序列数量不同,但四种模式在常规神经成像实践中是一致和常用的: T1-加权(T1), T2-加权(T2), Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery(FLAIR),以及对比增强的T1-加权成像(T1c). 这些模式提供关于解剖结构、损伤特征、水肿、增强模式和病理组织特性的补充诊断信息。 因此,我们选择了这四个量子核磁共振序列作为我们评价方法的主要投入。 如图3所示,对于每个病人,我们首先按研究和顺序组织DICOM文件,然后利用元数据储存的空间信息,包括切片位置、图像方向和阴道间距,将订购的切片组成体积磁共振扫描。 由于原始扫描是根据不同的临床协议获得的,因此重建的卷数在方向、空间分辨率、视野和矩阵大小方面可能有所不同。 为了减少这种可变性,所有3D卷被重印到1×1×1×1×1×1毫米的对映空间分辨率. 然后我们用HD-BET[17]应用自动脑提取来获取脑罩,这些面具被用来抑制非脑组织,并收割颅内区域. 这一步骤消除了不相关的背景结构,同时保留临床上有意义的解剖上下文,使模型能够将每个序列作为标准化的3D体积处理,同时保持解剖跨切片的连续性.

blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集特征

blocks.en:
Our brain MRI dataset contains 3,649 studies
with heterogeneous sequence availability and diverse clinical findings. Most studies include T1, T2, and FLAIR sequences accounting for 2,411 cases. A smaller subset of 939 studies contains all four sequences, while 283 studies include T2, FLAIR, and T1c. Other modality combinations are rare.
This distribution indicates that the dataset is dominated by several common acquisition patterns while still reflecting the variability of routine clinical MRI protocols. As shown in Fig. 2 a, this modality imbalance highlights the need for models that can handle incomplete or inconsistent multi-sequence inputs. To characterize the clinical content of the dataset, we extracted structured clinical labels from the radiology reports. We first identified recurrent expressions describing anatomical regions, laterality, abnormal findings, Fazekas grades, and absence of abnormality. A large language model was used to suggest mappings between semantically equivalent expressions, which were subsequently reviewed and verified by a radiologist. Based on the verified mappings, regular-expression rules were constructed to assign each report a multi-label set.

我们的脑磁共振数据集包含3,649项研究

blocks.en: In addition, the abnormal findings follow a long-tailed distribution (Fig. 2 b). Small vessel disease is the most common abnormality, followed by sinus mucosal thickening, cerebral infarction, hemorrhage, sinus fluid retention, cysts, and mass lesions or tumors. Less frequent findings among the top ten include mastoid fluid retention, brain atrophy, and white matter degeneration. As shown in Fig. 2 c, the anatomical distribution of the most commonly mentioned regions include the paranasal sinuses, ventricles, periventricular region, deep white matter, subcortical white matter, frontal lobe, and basal ganglia. In addition, a single report may contain multiple co-existing findings across different anatomical regions, such as concurrent chronic small vessel disease, sinus abnormalities, infarction, hemorrhage, or mass-related findings. Therefore, the report generation task is not limited to predicting a single dominant abnormality, but requires the model to describe multiple abnormalities and their corresponding anatomical locations within the same study. These statistics suggest that the dataset covers both intracranial abnormalities and extracranial incidental findings, while also exhibiting substantial imbalance across disease categories and anatomical locations. Such characteristics make report generation challenging, as the model must learn from heterogeneous multi-sequence inputs, frequent routine findings, rare but clinically significant abnormalities, and complex anatomical descriptions.
blocks.zh: 此外,异常结果也跟随长尾分布(图2b). 细小的血管疾病是最常见的异常现象,其次是鼻窦黏膜增厚,脑梗塞,出血,鼻窦液保留,囊肿,以及质量损伤或肿瘤. 前十名中不太常见的发现包括:乳头液保留、脑萎缩和白物质退化。 如图2c所示,最常提到的地区的解剖分布包括伞形鼻塞,通风管,透视区域,深白质物,亚冠白质物,前叶,和玄武岩群. 此外,单一报告可能包含不同解剖区域的多种共同发现,如同时存在的慢性小血管疾病、鼻窦异常、梗死、出血或与质量有关的发现。 因此,报告生成任务并不限于预测单一的主导异常,而是要求模型描述多种异常及其在同一研究中相应的解剖位置. 这些统计数据表明,数据集既涵盖颅内异常,也涵盖颅外偶然发现,同时显示出疾病类别和解剖地点之间的严重不平衡。 这种特征使得报告生成具有挑战性,因为模型必须学习多种多序列输入、频繁的例行发现、罕见但临床上显著的异常以及复杂的解剖描述。

blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Our experiments are designed to answer the following main research questions:
blocks.zh: 我们的实验旨在回答以下主要的研究问题:

blocks.en: RQ1: How large is the cross-dataset generalization gap between MR-RATE and ViBMR?
blocks.zh: RQ1:MR-RATE和ViBMR之间的跨数据集通用化差距有多大?

blocks.en: RQ2: Do segmentation-pretrained multi-sequence MRI encoders improve brain MRI report generation?
blocks.zh: RQ2:分解预导多序列核磁共振编码器是否改善大脑核磁共振报告生成?.

blocks.en: RQ3: Which fusion strategy is most effective for multi-sequence MRI report generation?
blocks.zh: RQ3:哪个聚变策略对多序列核磁共振报告生成最为有效?.

blocks.en: RQ4: How do MRI sequences and modality combinations affect report generation?

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of the proposed MRI report generation pipeline. Raw MRI slices from axial, sagittal, and coronal views are first reconstructed into 3D volumes with different input shapes, followed by voxel-size normalization, brain cropping, and organization into four cropped 3D MRI modalities: FLAIR, T1c, T1, and T2. Each modality is processed by a separate encoder, and the resulting modality-specific visual features are fused before token extraction. The zoom-in panel illustrates the fusion variants evaluated in this study, including mean fusion, learnable weighted fusion, spatial gating, channel gating, mean-query cross-attention, and the M2FTrans-MMFT bottleneck-based fusion strategy.

blocks.en: We use four MRI sequences as input, namely FLAIR, contrast-enhanced T1 (T1c), T1, and T2, as shown in Fig. 3 . To handle variations in volume size, each study is divided into overlapping 3D patches of size 128 × 128 × 128 128\times 128\times 128 with a stride of 64 64 along each spatial dimension. If a volume is smaller than the patch size, zero padding is applied before patch extraction. Missing sequences are represented by a modality availability mask and are ignored during modality fusion. For each patch, modality-specific features are extracted by the encoder branches of a segmentation-pretrained M2FTrans [ 33 ] or mmFormer [ 42 ] model and the segmentation decoder branches are removed. Specifically, the FLAIR, T1c, T1, and T2 volumes are passed through corresponding modality encoders, and we take the high-level feature maps before the original bottleneck fusion module. This produces a tensor of shape [ P , 4 , 128 , 8 , 8 , 8 ] [P,4,128,8,8,8] for each study, where P P denotes the number of extracted patches, 4 4 denotes the four MRI sequences, 128 128 is the feature dimension, and 8 × 8 × 8 8\times 8\times 8 is the spatial feature grid.

blocks.en: The first three variants correspond to increasingly adaptive weighted aggregation. Mean fusion simply averages the available modality feature maps at each patch and spatial location. Learnable weighted fusion assigns one trainable global importance score to each MRI sequence, normalizes the scores over available modalities using masked softmax, and shares the resulting weights across patches, spatial locations, and channels. Spatial gating further extends this idea by predicting location-dependent modality weights over the 3D feature grid, allowing different anatomical regions to emphasize different MRI sequences.

The projected visual embeddings are concatenated with the textual prompt embeddings and fed into Qwen3-4B-Instruct. The model is trained to generate the findings section of the Vietnamese brain MRI report.

blocks.en: We split ViBMR into train/validation/test sets with an 8/1/1 ratio at the patient level. Each patient contributes exactly one MRI study, with no patient overlap across splits. During report-generation training, we optimize the fusion module, the visual projector, and the LoRA parameters of the language model. We use LoRA with rank r = 16 r=16 , scaling factor α = 32 \alpha=32 , and dropout rate 0.05 0.05 . All fusion variants are trained under the same optimization setting for a fair comparison. We train for 20 epochs with a batch size of 1 and use gradient accumulation over 8 steps. The maximum number of visual tokens is set to 64, and the maximum target report length is set to 1024 tokens. We use AdamW as the optimizer. The learning rate is set to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} for both the fusion module and the visual projector, and 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for LoRA parameters.

blocks.en: 5.2 Result and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果和分析

blocks.en: RQ1 . Cross-dataset Generalization.
blocks.zh: RQ1 (英语). 跨数据集通论.

blocks.en: Models trained on MR-RATE show limited generalization to Vietnamese-origin reports. To examine this, we use an M2FTrans and Qwen3-4B-Instruct [ 39 ] baseline, where the segmentation-pretrained M2FTrans bottleneck is fine-tuned jointly with LoRA adapters in the LLM. We randomly sample 899 brain MRI cases from MR-RATE and split them into training, validation, and test sets with an 8:1:1 ratio. The model is trained on MR-RATE, then evaluated on both the held-out MR-RATE test split and the ViBMR test set. For ViBMR, reports are translated into English using the GPT-5.4 API model [ 30 ] , while preserving medical keywords and domain-specific terminology. As shown in Figure 4 , performance of the model drops from 29.50 to 18.85 BLEU-1, 13.68 to 1.03 BLEU-4, and 33.48 to 16.68 ROUGE-L when moving from MR-RATE to ViBMR test set. The largest gaps occur in ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2, both exceeding 18 points, indicating a substantial cross-dataset performance gap. However, this experiment does not isolate the specific source of this degradation. Possible contributing factors include translation artifacts, differences in reporting style and clinical expression, population and disease distributions, scanner and imaging protocol differences, and overall dataset composition. Therefore, the observed gap should be interpreted as evidence of cross-dataset domain shift rather than being attributed to any single factor. These results suggest that ViBMR provides a complementary setting for studying the robustness and cross-dataset generalization of medical vision-language models in a low-resource clinical and linguistic context.
blocks.zh: 接受MR-RATE培训的模型显示,对来自越南的报告的概括有限。 为了检查这一点,我们使用一个M2FTrans和Qune3-4B-指令[39]基线,其中分解前训练的M2FTrans瓶颈与LLM中的LORA适配器一起进行微调. 我们随机从MR-RATE中抽取899个脑磁共振病例,并用8:1的比例将其分为训练,验证和测试组. 该模型在MR-RATE上接受训练,然后在被搁置的MR-RATE测试分裂和ViBMR测试集上进行评价. 对于ViBMR,报告使用GPT-5.4 API模型[30]翻译为英文,同时保留医学关键词和特定领域的术语. 如图4所示,该型号的性能从29.50降至18.85BLEU-1,13.68降至1.03BLEU-4,在从MR-RATE转向ViBMR测试集时,33.48降至16.68ROUGE-L. 最大的差距发生在ROUGE-1和ROUGE-2,两者均超过18分,表明存在重大的跨数据集性能差距. 然而,这一实验并没有孤立这种退化的具体根源. 可能的促成因素包括翻译文物,报告风格和临床表现的不同,人口和疾病分布,扫描仪和成像协议的差异,以及整体数据集组成. 因此,所观察到的差距应被解释为跨数据集域转移的证据,而不是归因于任何单一因素。 这些结果表明,ViBMR为研究低资源临床和语言背景下医疗视觉语言模型的稳健性和跨数据集概括性提供了一个补充环境.

blocks.en: Segmentation-pretrained multi-sequence MRI encoders provide stronger visual representations for brain MRI report generation than the evaluated single-modality baselines. Using the default setting of the encoder baselines, under the same LoRA adapter setting on the decoder-side, the M2FTrans encoder with Qwen3-4B-Instruct achieves the best performance in six of seven metrics, as shown in Table 2 . Moreover, mmFormer encoder baseline also obtains competitive results and ranks second on most metrics, indicating that segmentation-pretrained MRI encoders can be effectively transferred from dense prediction tasks to clinical text generation. The comparison further suggests that multi-sequence input is important for generating more accurate brain MRI reports. M2FTrans and mmFormer baselines can process multiple MRI sequences simultaneously, whereas AutoRG-Brain and M3D are evaluated using single-modality input. Their stronger overall performance also indicates that complementary information from different MRI sequences provides richer visual evidence for report generation. Although AutoRG-Brain obtains the highest ROUGE-1 score, its lower scores across the remaining metrics suggest that this advantage is mainly limited to unigram-level overlap and does not consistently extend to longer phrase-level, semantic, or clinical agreement. These results answer RQ2 by showing that segmentation-pretrained multi-sequence MRI encoders are effective visual backbones for brain MRI report generation.
blocks.zh: 分解预导多序列核磁共振编码器为脑磁共振报告生成提供了比所评价的单模式基线更强的视觉表现. 使用编码器基线的默认设置,在解码器侧面相同的LORA适配器设置下,使用Qune3-4B-Instruct的M2FTrans编码器在7个度量衡中的6个实现最佳性能,如表2所示. 此外,mmFormer编码器基线也获得了竞争结果,并排在大多数度量衡的第二位,这表明分解预导核磁共振编码器可以从密集的预测任务有效转移到临床文本生成. 比较进一步表明,多序列输入对于生成更准确的脑磁共振报告很重要. M2FTrans和mmFormer基线可以同时处理多个核磁共振序列,而AutoRG-Brain和M3D则使用单模式输入来评价. 它们的总体性能更强还表明,来自不同核磁共振序列的补充信息为编写报告提供了更丰富的视觉证据。 虽然AutoRG-Brain获得了最高的ROUGE-1分数,但其在剩余度量衡上的较低分数表明,这一优势主要局限于单语级重叠,且不能始终延伸到更长的短语级,语义,或临床协议. 这些结果对RQ2的回答是,通过显示分解预留的多序列核磁共振编码器是大脑核磁共振报告生成的有效视觉骨干.

blocks.en: RQ3 . Effect of Different Fusion Strategies.
blocks.zh: RQ3 不同融合策略的效果.

blocks.en: For M2FTrans, mean fusion achieves the highest BLEU-4 and Clinical-F1, while channel gating leads in ROUGE-2 and BERTScore. For mmFormer, weighted fusion performs best on BLEU-4, ROUGE-2, and BERTScore, whereas mean fusion leads in Clinical-F1 (Table 3 ). Overall, lightweight fusion methods generally outperform CrossAttn-MeanQ, suggesting that segmentation-pretrained features can be effectively aggregated without complex attention mechanisms. However, the optimal fusion strategy varies across encoders and evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 对M2FTrans来说,平均聚变实现最高的BLEU-4和临床-F1,而信道吉丁在ROUGE-2和BERTScore中领先. 对于mmFormer,加权聚变在BLEU-4、ROUGE-2和BERTScore上表现最好,而在临床-F1中则意味着聚变铅(表3)。 总体而言,轻量级聚变方法一般优于CrossAttn-MeanQ,说明分化前置特征无需复杂的关注机制就可以有效聚合. 然而,最佳聚变战略因编码器和评价度量标准而异。

blocks.en: RQ4 . Contribution of Different MRI Sequences.
blocks.zh: RQ4 (英语). 不同磁共振序列的贡献。

blocks.en: For this modality ablation study, we select the two best-performing fusion strategies and two original baselines, evaluating selected modality combinations on the same subset of 939 studies containing all four sequences. Different combinations are constructed by masking selected sequences. As shown in Table 4 , most methods benefit from multi-sequence inputs, with the strongest performance generally obtained using T1+T2+FLAIR or all four modalities. However, improvements vary across fusion strategies. In particular, M2FTrans-MMFT achieves relatively consistent performance across modality combinations, potentially benefiting from its pretrained fusion tokens that capture modality relationships. Overall, these results highlight the benefits of complementary MRI sequences, the effectiveness of T1+T2+FLAIR, and the importance of fusion design for exploiting multi-modality information.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced ViBMR, a large-scale multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports, and presented a systematic study of automated brain MRI report generation. Our experiments show that segmentation-pretrained multi-sequence MRI encoders provide effective visual representations, while lightweight fusion strategies such as mean fusion, weighted fusion, and gating are generally more stable than complex attention-based fusion. We also observe that multi-sequence inputs improve report generation and that models trained on existing English MRI-report datasets exhibit a clear generalization gap when evaluated on Vietnamese-origin reports. These findings highlight the importance of clinically grounded low-resource datasets and robust multi-sequence fusion for future brain MRI report generation systems.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了ViBMR,这是一个大型的多序列脑核磁共振数据集,与越南常规临床报告对齐,并介绍了自动化脑核磁共振报告生成的系统研究. 我们的实验表明,分解预导的多序列核磁共振编码器提供了有效的视觉表现,而轻量级聚变策略,如平均聚变,加权聚变,以及吉丁一般比复杂的基于注意力的聚变更稳定. 我们还注意到,多序列投入改善了报告的生成,在评价越南原产地报告时,关于现有英文核磁共振报告数据集的培训模型显示出明显的概括差距。 这些研究结果突出了临床基础的低资源数据集和强力的多序列聚变对于未来脑磁共振报告生成系统的重要性.
